pages.text: Silicon is a key material used in crafting electronic components for Refined Storage. It is created by processing quartz in a specific way.
Features:$(li)Used in electronic components$(li)Required for processors$(li)Can be cut into smaller pieces$(li)Essential for advanced crafting
To craft Silicon:$(li)Process quartz in a specific way$(li)Can be automated with machines$(li)Used in many device recipes$(li)Can be stored in bulk
